feeds.title: The Green Register Blog
feeds.description: The Green Register trains construction professionals from all disciplines of the industry to build better, more sustainable buildings. Whether you are interested in a new home for you or a client, workplaces, cinemas, stadiums or any other types of building, by sharing our passions and knowledge of energy, health and well-being, land use, materials, pollution, transport, waste and water we can support you to reduce your building's impact on the environment.

feeds.title: Green Travel Blog » Architecture
feeds.description: Green Travel Blog is trying to find a balance between usage and limits by planning on a long-term basis. This means, protecting the environment and local culture as well as improving the social balance in the regions.

feeds.title: Encore Sustainable Architects Blog
feeds.description: Encore is a boutique architectural design firm specializing in historic preservation, adaptive reuse, and sustainability. Our team is led by veteran architect W. Ward Bucher, AIA, APT, and consists of architects, preservationists, and sustainable designers with advanced degrees, licenses, and certifications.

feeds.title: Modece Architects Blog
feeds.description: At Modece we focus on 'deep green architecture' - using materials with the lowest possible embodied energy and serviced by carbon neutral systems. Our architecture responds to seasonal weather variations and climate change using simple design principles such as orientation, mass, solar shading, and natural ventilation.

feeds.title: Gilbert Architects Blog
feeds.description: For over 30 years, Gilbert Architects Inc. has been a full-service architectural firm devoted exclusively to planning and designing educational facilities for clients throughout the Mid-Atlantic region. Read the latest news from our sustainable architecture blog. Gilbert Architects is devoted exclusively to planning and designing educational facilities.

feeds.title: Eco Edition
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Eco Edition - Design inspiration and resources for homeowners who want to create their own sustainable and healthy homes. I'm Nadine Samwell and with over 15 years of experience as an interior designer and a renovator for over 20 years, I'll bring you stories full of stunning photos and handy tips to help you get started on your journey of creating your own comfortable, sustainable and healthy home - whatever that looks like for you.

feeds.title: Ciarcelluti Mathers Architecture
feeds.description: We are a wife and husband team, we're the perfect combination of Italian flair and Canadian pragmatism, and when you bring us on board, you get both that creativity and that practical mindset from start to finish. This Architecture Blog specifically focuses on imparting knowledge from experience in Green and Sustainable Homes over the years!

feeds.title: Sustainable Design Group Blog
feeds.description: At Sustainable Design Group, our mission is to design and build the most comfortable, healthy, and environmentally responsible buildings on the planet. We work with passive solar design and active technologies to harness the solar, wind, and biological cycles to provide a complete life support system for our clients through integrated biomimicry design.

feeds.title: Samuel Kendall Associates News
feeds.description: We are an RIBA Chartered, leading Yorkshire Architects practice, creating distinctive, sustainable family homes. We believe 21st century homes should bring joy and delight whilst removing their environmental impact through passive solar design, renewable energy strategies & sustainable, low-carbon materials. We are an award-winning family practice that over the last 22 years have worked closely with families to achieve their dreams of sustainable, healthy places to call home.

feeds.title: LEED Blogger
feeds.description: LEED Blogger is a blog related to Green Building. Get to know everything about the sustainable architecture at LEED Blogger.

feeds.title: Broadway Architects
feeds.description: A blog about Redefining Sustainability, sustainable environmental design, and sacred ecology. Authored by Rob Sieniuc, Green Architect & Environmental Designer with a design philosophy deeply rooted in ecology & community.

feeds.title: Green Architecture and Building Report
feeds.description: The Green Architecture and Building Report (GAB Report) is a resource for sharing information on responsible, green, and sustainable design, ranging from the architecture to the building details, and from the site features to the building products.

feeds.title: Herzing College Blog » Sustainable-architecture
feeds.description: At Herzing College, for over 55 years we've been helping people transition back to school and into fulfilling careers, including students with busy schedules and tight budgets. Read expert advice from the Herzing College Blog to help you understand the importance of sustainable architecture in the future and how it impacts the life surrounding it.

feeds.title: Anderson Sustainable Architecture Blog
feeds.description: Anderson Sustainable Architecture is a full-service architectural firm. Our firm has chosen to specialize in energy sustainable design. Anderson Sustainable Architecture develops building design solutions for clients with a focus on life-style tailored, flexible use, energy sustainability, health and comfort, financial return on investment, and design beauty.

feeds.title: Prasoon Design Studio » Sustainable Architecture
feeds.description: Prasoon Design Studio is an architecture and design firm specializing in hospitality, residential, commercial, retail, and institutional projects. We deliver iconic concepts deeply rooted in sustainable development, cutting-edge technologies & bio-climatic design to arrive at bespoke architectural solutions.

feeds.title: Natural Building Blog
feeds.description: The Natural Building Blog is committed to providing free information that will improve people's lives in a sustainable and affordable manner. This includes architecture, homesteading, gardening, appropriate technology and ecological living.

feeds.title: Inhabitat » Architecture
feeds.description: Inhabitat is a website dedicated to green design, innovation, and the future of clean technology, cataloging great ideas and emerging technologies which will change our world for the better. Read about Sustainable architecture at Inhabitat.

feeds.title: Econaur » Sustainable Architecture
feeds.description: Econaur is India's first integrated platform for Green Building Solutions, which provides one-stop solution for energy efficient buildings. Econaur provides a platform where you can explore eco-friendly products, in addition to the expert guidance from building consultants and comparison between green and non-green products on a single platform. Our vision is to bring each individual together in this revolution so that we do not only keep our environment safe but also repay what we have reaped as a human race.

feeds.title: Green Building Elements
feeds.description: A website dedicated to green construction and buildings. It contains the ideas and design behind them, materials used to build them and how we grow as society using sustainability and urban growth. From brick and mortar shops to city planning, we cover sustainable trends.

feeds.title: SABMag
feeds.description: Sustainable Architecture & Building Magazine [SABMag] covers sustainable, high-performance buildings and renovations of all types in Canada. It provides profiles of new and renovated buildings and reports on products, technologies, and trends in Canadian sustainable design.

feeds.title: Building Design + Construction » Sustainability
feeds.description: Building Design+Construction is the only innovation and technology media platform serving the entire design and construction process for the commercial buildings industry. We cover, and inspire a sustainable approach toward architecture through our articles and blog posts.

feeds.title: The Design Files » Sustainable Homes
feeds.description: Trying to find sustainable ideas for your home? Look no further! The Design Files brings you top-notch and brilliant ideas to decorate your home in a sustainable way. The Design Files is Australia's most popular digital design publication. We cover real Australian homes, gardens, art, architecture, interior design, furniture, textiles, homewares, food, and more!
